s10.old: - **READ THE PREVIOUS SENTENCE BEFORE DEBUGGING AN ANIMATION. 2026-08-18: I did not, and burned five rounds "diagnosing" correct code.** In the Claude_Browser pane `document.visibilityState` is `'hidden'` and **rAF fires ZERO frames**, and it STAYS hidden after `tabs_select` / fronting, so you cannot fix it by fronting the tab. `computer{action:'screenshot'}` also refuses ("the Browser pane is not displayed, so the page is not compositing frames"). An rAF-driven tween therefore executes its synchronous frame 0 (which by construction sets position = start) and then freezes, so **working code presents exactly as "the feature does nothing"**, and every assertion downstream fails, which reads as a broken implementation rather than a broken harness.
s10.why: "READ THE PREVIOUS SENTENCE" is the rAF-throttling bullet right before it in ## Preview and verification workflow, which moves whole to -preview-and-desk-rules

Downstream regen skipped (that day's post-merge chain had already built all display artifacts from this exact content). Lesson: an mtime-stale flag is a lead, not proof of content drift.
